bumpRationale: Minor: catches up release metadata for two PRs merged after v1.6.1 that shipped without a version bump — (1) a branded in-app /login screen replacing the Base44-hosted login redirect (PR #148), and (2) a critical RLS fix restoring the service-role admin branch on UserProfile/PendingChange/School/AuditLog that had silently broken onboarding and role-approval app-wide (PR #149). This release's audit re-verified both: the login screen introduces no credential-handling, XSS, open-redirect, or tenant-isolation issues, and the RLS restore does not reopen C1/C2 (field-level RLS locks on app_role/status/approver_* are untouched; the restored branch only matches the synthetic service-role identity, never a real end-user). Also wires typecheck and build into CI (previously only lint/RLS/test/release-gate ran in ci-node.yml). 271 tests pass; lint clean; typecheck clean; RLS validation green (32 entities); release gate green (23/23); build succeeds; npm audit — 0 vulnerabilities.

architecture.runtime: browser (client-side only; no application server) + Base44 backend functions for privileged mutations
architecture.enforcementBoundary: base44 Row-Level Security (entity + field-level RLS) in base44/entities/*.jsonc + service-role backend functions in base44/functions/*
architecture.language: JavaScript / JSX (type-checked via jsconfig); Deno TypeScript for backend functions

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
